/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.

  `checkTrace` requires:
  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
    appears in some scene;
  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
    occupies both;
  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.

  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace TraceLint

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
    if !present s r.kind r.id then
      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"

private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The static map and the devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  match τ with
  | [] => []
  | s0 :: _ =>
    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
    τ.flatMap fun s =>
      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
        | none => none

private def devices (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let ids := (τ.flatMap fun s => s.devices.map (·.id)).eraseDups
  let first := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? (·.device d)
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (ids.filterMap fun d => match first d with
      | some dv => if !dv.mobile && (s.device d).isNone then some s!"{at_ s}: device {d} is missing; a device that does not move is in every scene" else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.devices.filterMap fun dv => match first dv.id with
      | some d0 =>
        if reprStr d0.staticPart != reprStr dv.staticPart then
          some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} differs from its first appearance in a field that is not its state (its state is {String.intercalate ", " Device.stateFields}{if d0.mobile then ", position" else ""})"
        else none
      | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Representation: where a designated direction and a device's control are written
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The structure kinds a vehicle travels in that may carry a designated direction. A centre turn
    lane, shared by both directions, carries none. -/
def directionKinds : List StructureKind :=
  [.lane, .reservedLane, .turnLane, .bicycleLaneOrPath, .roadway, .oneWayRoadway, .shoulder]

/-- The structure kinds a device may govern: the kinds refining the travel region, the regions
    whose traffic it controls and an intersection, read as control of the junction itself and of
    nothing else. -/
def governedKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => !k.isAbstract && k.refines .travelRegion

/-- The structure kinds that mark a carrier's entrance into an intersection. -/
def entranceKinds : List StructureKind := [.stopLine, .crosswalk]

/-- The structure kinds that carry an entrance into an intersection: those of
    `StructureKind.entranceCarriers` and every kind refining one of them. -/
def carrierKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => StructureKind.entranceCarriers.any (k.refines ·)

/-- The kinds a region may have at each region argument of an atom or primitive, keyed by its Lean
    name and the argument's index in its full argument list: `some ks` where the field the name reads
    there is carried by, or may name, only a region whose kind is in `ks` (the lists this check and
    `Scene.references` hold the field to); `none` where a region of any kind may stand there. A class
    atom `st_<kind>` reads the label every region has and is `none`. -/
def regionArgKinds : List ((String × Nat) × Option (List StructureKind)) :=
  let refining := fun (ks : List StructureKind) => StructureKind.all.filter fun k => ks.any (k.refines ·)
  [(("st_lane_enters", 0), some carrierKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 0), some entranceKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 1), some (refining StructureKind.entranceCarriers)),
   (("st_lane_direction", 0), some directionKinds),
   (("dev_governs", 1), some governedKinds),
   (("st_sight_along_way", 1), some (refining StructureKind.sightWays)),
   (("prim_region_offset_along", 2), some directionKinds)]
  ++ ([("st_lane_enters", 1), ("rel_occupies", 1), ("st_road_edge_paved", 0), ("st_shoulder_paved", 0),
       ("st_median_or_divider_opening", 0), ("st_crosswalk_marked", 0), ("st_reserved_lane_class", 0),
       ("st_turn_lane_side", 0), ("st_parking_space_designation", 0), ("st_curb_zone_kind", 0),
       ("st_curb_zone_colour", 0), ("st_obstruction_kind", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 2),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 1), ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 1), ("st_lane_connectivity", 0), ("st_lane_connectivity", 1), ("st_on_way", 0),
       ("st_on_way", 1), ("st_lane_marking", 0), ("st_lane_marking_left", 0), ("st_lane_marking_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_count", 0), ("st_lane_width", 0), ("st_curvature", 0),
       ("st_grade", 0), ("st_sight_distance", 0), ("st_parking_space_angle", 0), ("st_region_geometry", 0),
       ("st_region_geometry_distance", 1), ("prim_region_lateral_offset", 1), ("prim_region_offset_along", 1)]
      ++ StructureKind.all.map fun k => (s!"st_{k}", 0)).map (·, none)

private def representation (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstStructure := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s.t
  let firstDevice := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.device d).map fun _ => s.t
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
      -- the map is static, so each structure is reported once, at its first appearance
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t then []
      else match st.lane.bind (·.direction) with
        | none => []
        | some v =>
          (if directionKinds.contains st.kind then []
           else [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.direction; only a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder does"])
          ++ (if Q.isZero v.1 && Q.isZero v.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} lane.direction is the zero vector"] else []))
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).isNone || carrierKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.enters_intersection; only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind refining one, enters an intersection as an approach")
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || !st.entranceObserved || entranceKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries entrance_of; only a stop line or a crosswalk marks an entrance")
    ++ s.devices.flatMap fun dv =>
      if firstDevice dv.id != some s.t || !dv.governsObserved then []
      else dv.governs.filterMap fun r => match s.structure? r with
        | some st =>
          if governedKinds.contains st.kind then none
          else some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} governs structure {r} ({st.kind.toString}); a device governs the travel regions whose traffic it controls (a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, centre turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder) or an intersection"
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- What is wrong with a boundary, or nothing. -/
def boundaryErrors (poly : List Vec) : List String :=
  if poly.length < 3 then ["has fewer than three vertices"]
  else if !(dups poly).isEmpty then ["repeats a vertex (the first vertex is not repeated at the end)"]
  else if Q.isZero (Geom.area2 poly) then ["has zero area"]
  else if Geom.selfIntersects poly then ["intersects itself"]
  else []

private def geometry (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstOf := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      -- a structure is static, so its boundary is reported once, at its first appearance
      if (firstOf st.id).map (·.t) != some s.t then none
      else match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => match boundaryErrors poly with
          | [] => none
          | e :: _ => some s!"{at_ s}: the boundary of structure {st.id} {e}"
        | none => none)
    ++ (s.relations.filterMap fun m => match m.surfaceGap with
      | some (lon, lat) =>
        if Q.lt lon Q.zero || Q.lt lat Q.zero then
          some s!"{at_ s}: relation ({m.a}, {m.b}) surface_gap ({qs lon}, {qs lat}) has a negative component; each component is a distance between the bodies' nearest points, along and across a's heading, zero on contact or overlap"
        else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.tracks.flatMap fun x =>
      (match kin_extent s x with
       | some (l, w, _) => if Q.le l Q.zero || Q.le w Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} extent: the half-length and the half-width must be positive"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_path_length s x with
       | some p => if Q.lt p Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} path_length {qs p} is negative"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
       | none => [])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
  τ.map fun s =>
    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
      | none => []
      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
        | none => none
    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }

private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
  if obs.isEmpty then []
  else
    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
      if (footprint s t).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
      else none
    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
      else none
    bodies ++ unbounded

private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
      else match q0, q1 with
        | some a, some b =>
          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
          else []
        | _, _ => []

/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero

/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0

private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
        else
          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
          if wholeTurns turn then none
          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
      | _, _, _ => none

/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ

/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ

/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
  | some s =>
    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>
      if present s v.kind (match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d) then none
      else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: entity {n} is {kindName v.kind} {match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d}, which is not in this scene"

end TraceLint
end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
7	  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
8	  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
9	  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
10	  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
11	  arguments with no default.
12	
13	  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
14	  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]

  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/

  What a trace must satisfy, as written, before any rule is evaluated on it: the declared facts
  (assumptions and intentions) name what their scene holds, each once, by well-formed ids; no
  structure is labelled with an abstract kind or lists one among the kinds its source cannot tell
  (an abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it, read only by a formula); and the

  The checks are exact and read no geometry, so a recorded trace, a JSON case and a Lean witness

  there.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Identity
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Admission

private def duplicates {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups

/-- The defects of one scene's declared facts. -/
def sceneDefects (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let at_ := s!"scene t={s.t}"
  (s.intents.flatMap fun d =>
    let who := s!"{at_}: intent record ({d.vehicle}, {d.target})"
    (if s.tracks.contains d.vehicle then [] else [s!"{who}: vehicle {d.vehicle} is not a road user of the scene"]) ++
    (if (s.structure? d.target).isSome then [] else [s!"{who}: target {d.target} is not a structure of the scene"]) ++
    ((duplicates (d.values.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` listed more than once") ++
    ((d.values.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!IntId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` is not a well-formed intention id")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.intents.map fun d => (d.vehicle, d.target))).map fun (v, r) => s!"{at_}: more than one intent record for ({v}, {r})") ++
  (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
    (if st.kind.isAbstract then [s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} is labelled `{st.kind}`, an abstract kind; label it with a kind that refines `{st.kind}`"] else []) ++
    ((st.unobservedKinds.filter (·.isAbstract)).eraseDups.map fun k =>
      s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} lists `{k}` among unobserved_kinds, an abstract kind; list the kinds refining it that the source cannot tell")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.assumptions.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{at_}: assumption `{id}` listed more than once") ++
  ((s.assumptions.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!AsmId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{at_}: `{id}` is not a well-formed assumption id")

/-- Accepted links that give a track two successors or two predecessors. -/
def linkDefects (τ : Array Scene) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  let links := Grounding.acceptedLinks τ gap
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.1))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} is continued by more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.1 == t)}") ++
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.2))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} continues more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.2 == t)}")

/-- Every defect of the trace as written; empty for a trace every evaluation may read. -/
def defects (τ : Trace) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap sceneDefects ++ linkDefects τ.toArray gap

6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Grounding
7	  Which assignments of tracks to binders exist over a trace, how a broken track is followed, and
8	  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.
9	
10	  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
11	  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
12	  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
13	  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
14	  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.
15	
16	  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
17	  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
18	  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.
19	
20	  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.
21	-/
22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	namespace Grounding
27	open Semantics
28	
29	/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
30	    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
31	structure Grounding where
32	  assign : List (String × TrackId)
33	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
34	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
35	
36	def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
37	  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
38	def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
39	  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩
40	
41	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
43	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
45	def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
46	  let c := canon cm
47	  { s with
48	    subject := s.subject.map c
49	    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
50	    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
51	    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
52	    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
53	    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }
54	
55	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
56	-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
57	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	structure Setup where
59	  rules : List Rule
60	  d : Primitives.Ctx
61	  gap : Q
62	  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
63	
64	def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
65	  let arr := τ.toArray
66	  let cm := canonMap arr gap
67	  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }
68	
69	/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
70	    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
71	def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
72	  match Admission.defects τ gap with
73	  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
74	  | ds => .error ds

76	def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
77	def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
78	def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
79	def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
80	/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
81	def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
82	  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
83	  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
84	  | _, _ => none

86	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	-- Enumeration
88	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
89	/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
90	def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
91	  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
92	    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t
93	
94	def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
95	  match S.span a, S.span b with
96	  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1

100	    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
101	def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
102	  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
103	  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
104	    match bs with
105	    | [] => [[]]
106	    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
107	      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
108	        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
109	  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }
110	
111	/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
112	    bound when candidates overlap). -/
113	def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
114	  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1
115	
116	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
117	-- Timelines
118	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
119	/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
120	    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
121	    some instant at all. -/
122	structure Timeline where
123	  verdicts : Array (Timestamp × Verdict)
124	  live : Bool
125	  present : Bool
126	  deriving Repr
127	
128	/-- Evaluate a rule for a grounding once. A binder absent inside its identity's span is an
129	    identity gap (unknown); absent outside it, the rule is not engaged. -/
130	def evaluate (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Timeline :=
131	  let c := S.ctx g.binding
132	  let engaged := r.engagedAll c
133	  let obl := Rule.evalRuleFormula c r.obligation
134	  let spans := g.assign.map fun (_, t) => (t, S.span t)
135	  let rows := (Array.range S.n).map fun i =>
136	    let s := S.scenes[i]!
137	    let missing := spans.filter fun (t, _) => !s.tracks.contains t
138	    let v : Verdict :=
139	      if missing.isEmpty then verdictAt engaged[i]! obl[i]!
140	      else
141	        let inGap := missing.filter fun (_, sp) => match sp with
142	          | some (a, b) => a < i && i < b
143	          | none => false
144	        if inGap.isEmpty then .notApplicable
145	        else .unknown (inGap.map fun (t, _) => .identityGap t)
146	    (s.t, v, missing.isEmpty && engaged[i]!.v == .t, missing.isEmpty)
147	  ⟨rows.map fun (t, v, _, _) => (t, v), rows.any fun (_, _, l, _) => l, rows.any fun (_, _, _, p) => p⟩
148	
149	def timeline (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Array (Timestamp × Verdict) := (evaluate S r g).verdicts
150	
151	/-- The verdict of a grounding at one instant. -/
152	def verdictAt (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) (i : Nat) : Verdict :=
153	  ((timeline S r g)[i]?).map (·.2) |>.getD (.unknown [.outOfRange])
154	
155	/-- The episode verdict: a violation anywhere is a violation; else any unknown is unknown (with
156	    every reason); else engaged anywhere is compliant; else not applicable. -/
157	def episode (tl : List Verdict) : Verdict :=
158	  if tl.any (· == .violated) then .violated
159	  else
160	    let unknowns := tl.flatMap Verdict.reasons
161	    if tl.any (fun v => match v with | .unknown _ => true | _ => false) then .unknown unknowns.eraseDups
162	    else if tl.any (· == .compliant) then .compliant
163	    else .notApplicable
164	
165	/-- Every grounding evaluated once: its episode verdict and timeline. -/
166	def check (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List (Grounding × Timeline × Verdict) :=
167	  (groundings S r).map fun g =>
168	    let tl := evaluate S r g
169	    (g, tl, episode (tl.verdicts.toList.map (·.2)))
170	
171	/-- Engaged (applicability true) at some instant for some grounding: the rule says something on
172	    this trace. -/
173	def live (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Bool := (check S r).any fun (_, tl, _) => tl.live
174	
175	end Grounding
176	end TrafficSpec

/-

  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Grounding
  Which assignments of tracks to binders exist over a trace, how a broken track is followed, and
  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.

  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.

  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.

  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Grounding
open Semantics

/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
structure Grounding where
  assign : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
  let c := canon cm
  { s with
    subject := s.subject.map c
    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Setup where
  rules : List Rule
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  gap : Q
  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []

def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
  let arr := τ.toArray
  let cm := canonMap arr gap
  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }

/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
  match Admission.defects τ gap with
  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
  | ds => .error ds

def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
  | _, _ => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enumeration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t

def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
  match S.span a, S.span b with
  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
  | _, _ => false

/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
    match bs with
    | [] => [[]]
    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }

/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
    bound when candidates overlap). -/
def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Timelines
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
    some instant at all. -/
structure Timeline where
  verdicts : Array (Timestamp × Verdict)
  live : Bool
  present : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Evaluate a rule for a grounding once. A binder absent inside its identity's span is an
    identity gap (unknown); absent outside it, the rule is not engaged. -/
def evaluate (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Timeline :=
  let c := S.ctx g.binding
  let engaged := r.engagedAll c
  let obl := Rule.evalRuleFormula c r.obligation
  let spans := g.assign.map fun (_, t) => (t, S.span t)
  let rows := (Array.range S.n).map fun i =>
    let s := S.scenes[i]!
    let missing := spans.filter fun (t, _) => !s.tracks.contains t
    let v : Verdict :=
      if missing.isEmpty then verdictAt engaged[i]! obl[i]!
      else
        let inGap := missing.filter fun (_, sp) => match sp with
          | some (a, b) => a < i && i < b
          | none => false
        if inGap.isEmpty then .notApplicable
        else .unknown (inGap.map fun (t, _) => .identityGap t)
    (s.t, v, missing.isEmpty && engaged[i]!.v == .t, missing.isEmpty)
  ⟨rows.map fun (t, v, _, _) => (t, v), rows.any fun (_, _, l, _) => l, rows.any fun (_, _, _, p) => p⟩

def timeline (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Array (Timestamp × Verdict) := (evaluate S r g).verdicts

/-- The verdict of a grounding at one instant. -/
def verdictAt (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) (i : Nat) : Verdict :=
  ((timeline S r g)[i]?).map (·.2) |>.getD (.unknown [.outOfRange])

/-- The episode verdict: a violation anywhere is a violation; else any unknown is unknown (with
    every reason); else engaged anywhere is compliant; else not applicable. -/
def episode (tl : List Verdict) : Verdict :=
  if tl.any (· == .violated) then .violated
  else
    let unknowns := tl.flatMap Verdict.reasons
    if tl.any (fun v => match v with | .unknown _ => true | _ => false) then .unknown unknowns.eraseDups
    else if tl.any (· == .compliant) then .compliant
    else .notApplicable

/-- Every grounding evaluated once: its episode verdict and timeline. -/
def check (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List (Grounding × Timeline × Verdict) :=
  (groundings S r).map fun g =>
    let tl := evaluate S r g
    (g, tl, episode (tl.verdicts.toList.map (·.2)))

/-- Engaged (applicability true) at some instant for some grounding: the rule says something on
    this trace. -/
def live (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Bool := (check S r).any fun (_, tl, _) => tl.live

end Grounding
end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
3	  The specification language, as data.
4	
5	  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
6	  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
7	  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
8	  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.
9	
10	  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
11	  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
12	  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.
13	
14	  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
15	  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".
16	
17	  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
18	  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
19	  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.
20	
21	  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
22	  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
23	  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).
24	
25	  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
26	  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
27	-/
28	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
29	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
30	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
31	
32	namespace TrafficSpec
33	
34	/-- A value a formula variable can denote. -/
35	inductive Val
36	  | track (t : TrackId)
37	  | region (r : RegionId)
38	  | device (d : DeviceId)
39	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
40	
41	def Val.kind : Val → EntityKind
42	  | .track _ => .track
43	  | .region _ => .region
44	  | .device _ => .device
45	
46	/-- Variable bindings (the grounding's output; `Env` is the world's environment record). -/
47	structure Binding where
48	  binds : List (String × Val) := []
49	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
50	
51	namespace Binding
52	def lookup (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option Val := (e.binds.find? (·.1 == n)).map (·.2)
53	def bind (e : Binding) (n : String) (v : Val) : Binding := ⟨(n, v) :: e.binds.filter (·.1 != n)⟩
54	def track (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option TrackId :=
55	  match e.lookup n with | some (.track t) => some t | _ => none
56	def region (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option RegionId :=
57	  match e.lookup n with | some (.region r) => some r | _ => none
58	def device (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option DeviceId :=
59	  match e.lookup n with | some (.device d) => some d | _ => none
60	end Binding
61	
62	/-- An argument to an atom or a derived concept. -/
63	inductive Arg
64	  | var (name : String)      -- a bound variable
65	  | lit (value : String)     -- an enumeration value, spelled as in the ontology
66	  | nat (n : Nat)
67	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
68	
69	inductive CmpOp
70	  | lt | le | eq | ge | gt
71	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
72	
73	/-- What an aggregate over road users computes. -/
74	inductive AggOp
75	  | min | max | median | count
76	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
77	
78	def AggOp.toString : AggOp → String
79	  | .min => "min" | .max => "max" | .median => "median" | .count => "count"
80	instance : ToString AggOp := ⟨AggOp.toString⟩
81	
82	def CmpOp.apply : CmpOp → Q → Q → Bool
83	  | .lt, a, b => Q.lt a b
84	  | .le, a, b => Q.le a b
85	  | .eq, a, b => Q.eq a b
86	  | .ge, a, b => Q.ge a b
87	  | .gt, a, b => Q.gt a b
88	
89	mutual
90	  /-- A quantity. -/
91	  inductive Term
92	    | lit (q : Q) (unit : PUnit')                            -- written through a Units constructor
93	    | param (name : ParamName)                               -- a reading parameter
94	    | measure (atom : String) (args : List Arg)              -- a measured atom (Option Q or Option Nat)
95	    | quantity (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Q-valued derived concept
96	    | distanceWhile (subject : String) (φ : Formula)         -- path length over which φ has held continuously
97	    | sinceRise (φ : Formula)                                -- time elapsed since φ last became true
98	    /-- The signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of `subject`, integrated from its yaw
99	        rate, since ψ last became true: from the latest observation at which ψ rose definitely (false
100	        at the observation before, true there), counted from zero at that observation. ψ turning false
101	        does not end it, nor does a stop; only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again. Unknown
102	        where no such rise is observed with ψ known at every observation since (an onset before the
103	        recording, or one an unknown value of ψ could hide), where an interval between consecutive
104	        observations from the one before the rise onwards is longer than `maxStep`, or where a yaw
105	        rate since the rise is missing. `maxStep` is a literal or a reading parameter, a time,
106	        strictly positive: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on
107	        how far back the onset may lie. -/
108	    | headingSince (subject : String) (maxStep : Term) (ψ : Formula)   -- the heading change of subject since ψ last became true
109	    | aggregate (op : AggOp) (var : String) (φ : Formula) (t : Term)   -- op of t over the road users var of the scene satisfying φ
110	    | add (a b : Term)
111	    | sub (a b : Term)
112	    | mul (a b : Term)
113	    /-- `a / b`, unknown wherever `b` is zero. Its divisor reads no measured atom: a measurement can
114	        be zero (a straight way's curvature, a halted road user's speed), so a bound on a ratio is
115	        written as a bound on a product (a ratio below a bound is the dividend below the bound
116	        times the divisor). -/
117	    | div (a b : Term)
118	    | neg (a : Term)
119	    | abs (a : Term)
120	    | cond (φ : Formula) (a b : Term)                        -- a where φ holds, b where it does not
121	  /-- A three-valued statement about the trace at an instant. -/
122	  inductive Formula
123	    | tt
124	    | ff
125	    | atom (name : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean atom; params for tolerances
126	    | cmp (lhs : Term) (op : CmpOp) (rhs : Term)
127	    | asm (id : AsmId)
128	    | intent (id : IntId) (who target : Arg)                 -- the declaration current here: road user `who` intends `id` at region `target`
129	    | same (a b : Arg)                                        -- the two variables denote the same entity
130	    | not (φ : Formula)
131	    | and (φ ψ : Formula)
132	    | or (φ ψ : Formula)
133	    | implies (φ ψ : Formula)
134	    | always (φ : Formula)                                    -- from now to the end of the trace
135	    | eventually (φ : Formula)                                -- φ here or at some later observation, to the end of the trace
136	    | until (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- strong until, future
137	    | since (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- past mirror of until
138	    | holdsFor (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)   -- φ at every observation in the window behind
139	    | within (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)     -- φ at some observation in the window ahead
140	    | untilWithin (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ ψ : Formula)   -- ψ at some observation in the window ahead, φ at every one before it
141	    | atLast (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (ψ φ : Formula)   -- φ at the last observation in the window behind at which ψ held
142	    | count (edge : Formula) (sinceφ : Formula) (op : CmpOp) (n : Nat)   -- rising edges of `edge` since `sinceφ` became true (start of its latest run)
143	    | rises (φ : Formula)                                     -- φ here and not at the previous observation
144	    | definedWhen (pre φ : Formula)                           -- φ where `pre` holds; unknown (undefined) where it does not
145	    | derived (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean derived concept
146	    | rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String))       -- another rule complied with (not engaged counts as complied)
147	    | ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) -- another rule engaged (its binders' classes and applicability hold)
148	    | existsUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)                 -- some road user present in the scene
149	    | forallUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)
150	    | existsRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
151	    | forallRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
152	    | existsDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
153	    | forallDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
154	end
155	
156	deriving instance Repr for Term
157	deriving instance Repr for Formula
158	instance : Inhabited Formula := ⟨.tt⟩
159	instance : Inhabited Term := ⟨.lit Q.zero .count⟩
160	
161	namespace Formula
162	/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
163	def measureAtom : Measure → String
164	  | .time => "kin_time"
165	  | .path => "kin_path_length"
166	
167	/-- The kind atom a quantifier with a literal kind reads (`existsRegion (.lit "lane")` reads
168	    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/
169	def kindAtom (prefix_ : String) : Arg → List String
170	  | .lit k => [prefix_ ++ k]
171	  | _ => []
172	
173	-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
174	-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
175	mutual
176	  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String
177	    | .measure a _ => [a]
178	    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
179	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
180	    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ
181	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => "kin_yaw_rate" :: measureAtom .time :: (termAtoms g ++ atoms ψ)
182	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
183	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
184	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
185	    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
186	    | _ => []
187	  partial def atoms : Formula → List String
188	    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
189	    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
190	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
191	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
192	    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
193	    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
194	    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
195	    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
196	    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
197	    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
198	    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
199	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
200	    | _ => []
201	end
202	
203	-- The reading parameters a formula names.
204	mutual
205	  partial def termParams : Term → List ParamName
206	    | .param n => [n]
207	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
208	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => params φ
209	    | .sinceRise φ => params φ
210	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termParams g ++ params ψ
211	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => params φ ++ termParams t
212	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termParams a ++ termParams b
213	    | .neg a | .abs a => termParams a
214	    | .cond φ a b => params φ ++ termParams a ++ termParams b
215	    | _ => []
216	  partial def params : Formula → List ParamName
217	    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
218	    | .cmp l _ r => termParams l ++ termParams r
219	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => params φ
220	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => params φ ++ params ψ
221	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termParams d ++ params φ
222	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termParams d ++ params φ ++ params ψ
223	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termParams d ++ params ψ ++ params φ
224	    | .count e s _ _ => params e ++ params s
225	    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
226	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
227	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => params φ
228	    | _ => []
229	end
230	
231	-- The rules a formula composes, with each call's binder map, at any depth of formulas and terms.
232	mutual
233	  partial def termCompositions : Term → List (String × List (String × String))
234	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
235	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => compositions φ
236	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCompositions g ++ compositions ψ
237	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => compositions φ ++ termCompositions t
238	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
239	    | .neg a | .abs a => termCompositions a
240	    | .cond φ a b => compositions φ ++ termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
241	    | _ => []
242	  partial def compositions : Formula → List (String × List (String × String))
243	    | .rule id map | .ruleApplies id map => [(id, map)]
244	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
245	    | .cmp l _ r => termCompositions l ++ termCompositions r
246	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => compositions φ
247	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
248	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ
249	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
250	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions ψ ++ compositions φ
251	    | .count e s _ _ => compositions e ++ compositions s
252	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
253	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => compositions φ
254	    | _ => []
255	end
256	
257	/-- The rules a formula composes. -/
258	def composed (φ : Formula) : List String := (compositions φ).map (·.1)
259	
260	-- Numeric literals other than zero, with their units: what the gate holds against the node's
261	-- declared parameters (a magnitude belongs in the reading, not in a rule).
262	mutual
263	  partial def termLiterals : Term → List (Q × PUnit')
264	    | .lit q u => if Q.isZero q then [] else [(q, u)]
265	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
266	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => literals φ
267	    | .sinceRise φ => literals φ
268	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termLiterals g ++ literals ψ
269	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => literals φ ++ termLiterals t
270	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
271	    | .neg a | .abs a => termLiterals a
272	    | .cond φ a b => literals φ ++ termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
273	    | _ => []
274	  partial def literals : Formula → List (Q × PUnit')
275	    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
276	    | .cmp l _ r => termLiterals l ++ termLiterals r
277	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => literals φ
278	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => literals φ ++ literals ψ
279	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ
280	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ ++ literals ψ
281	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals ψ ++ literals φ
282	    | .count e s _ _ => literals e ++ literals s
283	    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
284	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
285	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => literals φ
286	    | _ => []
287	end
288	
289	/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
290	    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
291	def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
292	  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
293	  | _ => false
294	
295	/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
296	partial def leaves : Formula → List String
297	  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
298	  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
299	  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
300	  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
301	  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
302	  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
303	  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
304	  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
305	  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
306	  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
307	  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
308	  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
309	  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
310	  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
311	  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
312	  | _ => []
313	
314	def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length
315	
316	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
317	    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
318	partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
319	  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
320	    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
321	  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
322	  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
323	  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
324	  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
325	  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
326	  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
327	  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
328	  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
329	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
330	  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
331	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
332	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
333	  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
334	  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
335	  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
336	  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
337	  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
338	  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
339	  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
340	  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
341	  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
342	  | φ => (φ, 0)
343	where
344	  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
345	  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=
346	    let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ
347	    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
348	    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)
349	
350	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf replaced by `r`. -/
351	def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1
352	
353	-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.
354	mutual
355	  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
356	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
357	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => declared φ
358	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
359	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
360	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
361	    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a
362	    | .cond φ a b => declared φ ++ termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
363	    | _ => []
364	  partial def declared : Formula → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
365	    | .asm id => [.inl id]
366	    | .intent id _ _ => [.inr id]
367	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
368	    | .cmp l _ r => termDeclared l ++ termDeclared r
369	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => declared φ
370	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => declared φ ++ declared ψ
371	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ
372	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ ++ declared ψ
373	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared ψ ++ declared φ
374	    | .count e s _ _ => declared e ++ declared s
375	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
376	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => declared φ
377	    | _ => []
378	end
379	
380	/-- The assumptions a formula reads. -/
381	def assumptions (φ : Formula) : List AsmId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inl a => some a | .inr _ => none
382	/-- The declared intentions a formula reads. -/
383	def intentions (φ : Formula) : List IntId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inr i => some i | .inl _ => none
384	
385	-- The aggregate ids a formula names (`ru_aggregate x "<definition id>::<term>"`), at any depth of
386	-- formulas and terms, for the reading check.
387	mutual
388	  partial def termAggregateIds : Term → List String
389	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
390	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => aggregateIds φ
391	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termAggregateIds g ++ aggregateIds ψ
392	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds t
393	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
394	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAggregateIds a
395	    | .cond φ a b => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
396	    | _ => []
397	  partial def aggregateIds : Formula → List String
398	    | .atom "ru_aggregate" [_, .lit w] ps => w :: ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
399	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
400	    | .cmp l _ r => termAggregateIds l ++ termAggregateIds r
401	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => aggregateIds φ
402	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
403	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ
404	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
405	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds ψ ++ aggregateIds φ
406	    | .count e s _ _ => aggregateIds e ++ aggregateIds s
407	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
408	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => aggregateIds φ
409	    | _ => []
410	end
411	
412	/-- The first `cond` of a term reachable through arithmetic (not inside an aggregate or a window,
413	    whose body ranges over its own variable or instants), with the term rebuilt on each branch. -/
414	partial def splitCond : Term → Option (Formula × Term × Term)
415	  | .cond φ a b => some (φ, a, b)
416	  | .add x y => two .add x y
417	  | .sub x y => two .sub x y
418	  | .mul x y => two .mul x y
419	  | .div x y => two .div x y
420	  | .neg x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .neg a, .neg b)
421	  | .abs x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .abs a, .abs b)
422	  | _ => none
423	where
424	  two (k : Term → Term → Term) (x y : Term) : Option (Formula × Term × Term) :=
425	    match splitCond x with
426	    | some (φ, a, b) => some (φ, k a y, k b y)
427	    | none => (splitCond y).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, k x a, k x b)
428	
429	/-- Every comparison over a `cond` rewritten by cases: `(φ ∧ A) ∨ (¬φ ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ B)`, with `A` and
430	    `B` the comparison on each branch. Where φ is decided this is the selected branch; where φ is
431	    unknown it is decided exactly when both branches decide it alike. -/
432	partial def elimCond : Formula → Formula
433	  | .cmp l op r =>
434	    match splitCond l, splitCond r with
435	    | some (φ, a, b), _ => cases φ (.cmp a op r) (.cmp b op r)
436	    | none, some (φ, a, b) => cases φ (.cmp l op a) (.cmp l op b)
437	    | none, none => .cmp l op r
438	  | .not φ => .not (elimCond φ)
439	  | .and φ ψ => .and (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
440	  | .or φ ψ => .or (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
441	  | .implies φ ψ => .implies (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
442	  | .always φ => .always (elimCond φ)
443	  | .eventually φ => .eventually (elimCond φ)
444	  | .until φ ψ => .until (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
445	  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
446	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
447	  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
448	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
449	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
450	  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
451	  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
452	  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
453	  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
454	  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
455	  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
456	  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
457	  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
458	  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
459	  | φ => φ
460	where
461	  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
462	    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
463	    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)
464	end Formula
465	
466	end TrafficSpec
